name: geh_c4_v1
spec: PI-CV v0.1 criterion C4 (claim-to-passage support), test T-03 in miniature
source_document: Great Eastern Holdings Limited Annual Report 2025 (244 pp.), attached PDF; passages extracted with plumbverify 0.3.1 extract_pdf (pdftotext -layout + split_columns) and checked to occur verbatim (whitespace-normalised) on the stated page

splits.dev: 39 pairs; used while writing the offline rules
splits.heldout: 91 pairs; written before the matcher; evaluated once with rules frozen (first-run numbers below), then inspected and used for bug fixes, so it is no longer clean held-out data
splits.fresh: 45 pairs from pages 10 and 48-53, written after the first freeze and evaluated once before the last fix (counted_noun_mismatch); the author knew the rules when writing them

label_scheme.supported: the passage alone entails the whole claim (paraphrase allowed, hedges kept)
label_scheme.partial: part of the claim is supported; an added detail, scope, reason or dropped hedge/qualifier is not
label_scheme.unsupported: the passage contradicts the claim or lacks its core assertion: wrong number, entity, year or date; production-vs-pilot flip; direction or negation flip; superlative or approximation inflation

label_status: Labels are author-assigned by the pipeline developer and are NOT acceptance evidence. They must be re-labelled blind by the independent reviewer (spec C16) before any number derived from this file is quoted as T-03 evidence; the spec's T-03 needs >= 300 reviewer-labelled pairs.
